scoring_justification: Agent output is the final computed V_M; checker cannot recompute from raw structural data as they are not provided by the agent. Result-level compare against paper-reported gold values (Table 1 V_Msp column) and relative ordering trend.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported V_Msp (spectroscopic Madelung potentials) for eight orthophosphates (Table 1, last column). Used as gold for per-compound tolerance check.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Directly taken from Table 1 of the original paper (T. Chassé et al., J. Electron Spectrosc. Relat. Phenom., 62 (1993) 153-169). Column labeled V_Msp, values for the listed compounds.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Copied from the paper's Table 1 into this spec. The values are: Na3PO4 = -16.75, Ca3(PO4)2 = -16.10, Mn3(PO4)2 = -15.05, Ni3(PO4)2 = -15.50, InPO4 = -15.10, FePO4 = -15.10, GaPO4 = -14.95, BPO4 = -13.85.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual experimental spectroscopic estimates used as correctness reference; they are not synthetic or random. Provenance is traceable to the paper's table.

outputs.description: Computed ionicity-corrected Madelung potentials for eight orthophosphate compounds. The verifier compares each compound's V_M against a hidden reference value and assesses the relative ordering across compounds.
